jobs.occupation: Student trader for intraday power trading
jobs.description:
Join a world of energy as MFT's new student trader for the intraday power market

Are you our next student trader, and are you ready to learn the specifics of the intraday power trading? Join our ambitious intraday trading team of experienced colleagues, who strive to be the best and find the edge in the market every day, all day.

The job as a student trader

As a student trader, you will play a vital role in our trading team, assisting with trading and ensuring that all operational processes run smoothly. You’ll take part in developing and executing trading strategies and continuously analyzing market trends to identify profitable opportunities. You will be responsible for monitoring real-time data, making quick decisions, and collaborating with our full-time traders to ensure we seize the right market opportunities. This role offers an excellent opportunity for growth and development in the energy-trading industry.

We do not expect you to have experience in energy trading, but you should have a deep desire to learn and be interested in trading. If you have grit and hunger, we promise tailored training from some of the industry’s best traders and guarantee a fun work environment, a steep learning curve, and a unique career opportunity within intraday trading.

The work hours will mainly be evening shifts on weekdays and weekend shifts, which should fit well with your studies. Weekends might include night shifts.

Your key responsibilities

• Covering a student position (at least 15 hours per week on average) as part of a shift schedule in our high-performing intraday team – we trade 24/7, 365 days a year

• Daily trading and optimization of trading positions

• Continuously monitoring fundamental data such as solar and wind generation to take positions in a split second

• Continuous risk evaluation

• Always question the status quo

• Share insights to optimize and rethink the way we trade

Your qualifications and personal skills

• Currently studying a bachelor's or master’s degree in economics, finance, mathematics, or related degrees

• An interest in financial markets, stock trading, sports betting, or similar

• Have a competitive mindset and the ability to make informed decisions in a fast-paced environment, with the next deadline always coming up

• The ability and interest to learn about complex systems and methods quickly

• A positive and competitive person with grit, and at the same time, a great team player

• Can be direct with your colleagues and be able to receive direct constructive feedback

• Most importantly, a result-oriented mindset, always striving to be the best

Working in MFT Energy

At MFT Energy, we combine a startup mindset with the strength of a global organization. We believe in empowering individuals to make data-driven decisions in a fast-paced environment where collaboration, innovation, and entrepreneurial thinking are the cornerstones of our success. We are around 200 employees working out of our headquarters in Scandinavian Center in Aarhus C, and from our international offices in Turkey, Australia, USA, Singapore, Japan, and several remote colleagues working from all over the world.

We offer

• A fast-paced, global environment where entrepreneurial thinking is celebrated

• A people-centered leadership approach with a flat organizational structure

• Great employee benefits and a strong focus on employee wellbeing

• A high degree of autonomy and the freedom to make an impact

Make the most of your talent and join us!

If you think there is a fit between our values and your aspirations, we will look forward to receiving your application with a CV, grade transcripts, and a cover letter.

Tips for the cover letter:

The cover letter is our chance to get to know you beyond your resume: who you are, what motivates you, and what drives you in life. So please, make it as personal and authentic as possible. A cover letter written with AI often comes off as generic, as it'll be similar to the rest.

For questions, please contact career@mft-energy.com.

Deadline: Screening is ongoing, so apply as soon as possible.

Start date: As soon as possible.

jobs.occupation: SitaWare Expert? - use your experience in the service of national security and Infrastructure
jobs.description:
_

You have spent years working with command-and-control systems in the field — and you know exactly what they can do, and where they fall short. Now imagine applying that expertise to help define how battle-proven C2 technology protects power grids, police forces, national crisis authorities and critical infrastructure. This is a rare opportunity to move at the frontier of a genuinely new domain, with the market-leading platform and the mandate to shape it._

**The job

**

As Senior Domain Advisor, you'll be the go-to SitaWare expert across Systematic's National Security & Infrastructure (NSI) unit — the person colleagues, customers, and partners turn to when deep functional knowledge and operational credibility matter most. You'll configure and demonstrate SitaWare solutions in presales processes and customer engagements, and feed real-world operational insight directly into product development and roadmap discussions.

Equally important is your outward-facing role. Systematic is actively building its position as a thought leader at the intersection of defence-grade C2 technology and civil security — and you'll be central to that effort. Working across Crisis Management, Asset Protection, and Marine Coordination, you'll help customers in emergency services, critical infrastructure, police, and national crisis authorities understand what SitaWare can do for them, and you'll identify the new workflows and use cases that will take it further.

In short, you can look forward to:

•    Acting as SitaWare superuser: configuring and demonstrating solutions across presales, bids, and senior customer engagements

•    Translating military operational experience into concrete product and solution opportunities for the NSI domain

•    Advising product management and development teams — connecting real-world needs with SitaWare's evolving capabilities

•    Engaging senior stakeholders in emergency services, police, and critical infrastructure, building credibility through hands-on expertise

•    Contributing to thought leadership, use case development, and domain knowledge sharing across the unit.

**Joining the team

**

Systematic's NSI unit is one of the company's most significant growth areas, and one of its most strategically important. Built on the same SitaWare platform trusted by NATO and allied forces in more than 50 countries, NSI is translating four decades of defence-grade technology into solutions that protect the systems society depends on — from offshore energy infrastructure to national emergency coordination. The team works across Crisis Management, Asset Protection, and Marine Coordination, and the connections between those domains are exactly where the most interesting challenges live.

This is a new role, and deliberately so. You'll work closely with product managers, architects, developers, and business development managers — with real influence on where the unit goes next. The team is tight knit, highly capable, and genuinely values operational domain knowledge. Your experience won't sit in a drawer here; it will drive decisions.

Join us at the start of this exciting journey – we need your expertise and positive energy to help shape the future!

You can read more about our business unit National Security here and Critical Infrastructure here.

**Your qualifications

**

•    Military education at Captain or Major level, or equivalent

•    Solid operational experience from the Danish Army or equivalent force, with hands-on use of command-and-control systems in real or exercise environments

•    Direct experience with SitaWare — as an operational user, superuser, or in a configuration or advisory capacity

•    Strong IT proficiency at superuser level

•    Fluency in Danish and English, written and spoken

•    Experience supporting demonstrations, presentations or advisory work

•    Willingness to travel occasionally to customer sites and Systematic offices, nationally and internationally.

Please note that you must be able to present a clean criminal record and have lived in a NATO and/or EU country for the past seven years, as we work with security-classified projects. Read more: https://systematic.com/int/careers/security-clearance/

**Welcome to Systematic Aarhus

**

At our Aarhus office, you can look forward to joining our Employees Club, which offers nearly 100 events a year of both social and professional character. Here, you can take advantage of a range of on-site perks from physiotherapist-led massages and an in-house hairdresser to sports clubs, game tables and even our own padel court. Our canteen is a standout feature, serving a daily selection of delicious and healthy dishes. Beyond the office, you will also enjoy benefits like free ARoS +1 access and various shopping discounts.

**Never stop developing

**

Systematic is uniquely people-centric, truly international, and proudly rooted in Denmark with more than 1,100 employees. Together, we write intelligent and innovative code to drive progress and improve lives. We develop IT solutions that make a real difference where it matters most. This is why we never stop developing. Here, there is room to be professional and personal. It is not just a place to work but a place to belong.

**Start your development here

**

We will be assessing applications on an ongoing basis as we wish to welcome our new colleague as soon as possible, so click Apply Now and send us your CV today. If you have any questions, you are always welcome to contact us on tel. +45 8943 2000 and ask for Ole Spielberg.

jobs.occupation: Product Manager for Mobile Command and Control Products
jobs.description:
Product Manager for Mobile Command and Control Products

Channel your experience as an army officer into developing products that make a difference in the field. As part of Systematic’s Defence Product Management team, you will help shape the future of our SitaWare Mobile Command and Control products – developed for soldiers by someone who understands the job from the inside.

The role

Reporting to the Director of Product Management, you will join the product management team and collaborate closely with the Business Product Manager for our mobile C2 products. Together, you will help define the vision and strategy for our SitaWare Mobile Command and Control products. A core element of your role will be day-to-day guidance of the development team as a subject matter expert, ensuring that what we decide to build is implemented in a way that works effectively for soldiers in the field.

In short, you can look forward to:

• taking ownership of daily guidance of the development team, translating agreed features into implementation that works for soldiers in the field – ensuring user satisfaction

• using your subject matter expertise to define and manage the vision and strategy for enhancing and expanding our mobile command and control products

• serving as the voice of the customer and end user when implementing product enhancements

• providing the sales team with the necessary product knowledge, sales collateral and assistance in connection with special customer visits, and representing Systematic at conferences and trade shows

• being part of change control boards, helping prioritise defects and change requests based on what matters most to soldiers in the field

Joining the team

You will join our product management team in Systematic’s Defence Business Unit, working side by side with the Business Product Manager for mobile C2, our development teams and colleagues across sales, service and marketing. It is a team that cares about creating solutions that genuinely work for the people using them – if that is what drives you too, then you will feel right at home.

Your qualifications

Ideally, you will bring several years of experience from the armed forces – perhaps as an officer, company commander or in a signals or communications role – or from working closely with defence organisations. As a result, you will have first-hand insight into military operations, command and control at battalion level and below, and how systems are introduced and used in the field. That operational perspective will enable you to understand the end user and contribute relevant expertise to the development of our mobile C2 products.

To succeed in this role, you will need:

• the ability to turn operational insight and understanding of end-user needs into clear product requirements that development teams can act on

• a collaborative approach and the confidence to provide subject matter expertise across product management, development and sales teams

• strong written and verbal communication skills, with fluency in English and the confidence to present to larger audiences and to represent Systematic at customer presentations, user forums and conferences

We are also looking for someone who:

• is self-motivated and energetic, with a genuine drive to make a difference for the people who use the products you will help to build

• has a sense of curiosity and is well organised, with the ability to set priorities and keep pace with a growing product area

This role will involve approximately 20–30 days of travel a year, visiting customers, Systematic offices and events.

Please note that you must be able to present a clean criminal record and have lived in a NATO and/or an EU country for the past seven years, as we work on security-classified projects. Read more here.

Welcome to Systematic Aarhus

At our Aarhus office, you can look forward to joining our Employees Club, which offers around 100 events a year, both social and professional. Here, you can take advantage of a range of on-site perks from physiotherapist-led massages and an in-house hairdresser to sports clubs, game tables and even our own padel court. Our canteen is a standout feature, serving a daily selection of delicious and healthy dishes. Beyond the office, you will also enjoy benefits like free ARoS +1 access and a variety of shopping discounts.

Never stop developing

Systematic is uniquely people-centric, truly international and proudly rooted in Denmark, with more than 1100 employees. Together, we write intelligent and innovative code to drive progress and improve lives. We develop IT solutions that make a real difference where it matters most. This is why we never stop developing. There is room here to be professional and personal. It is not just a place to work but a place to belong.

Start your development here

We will be assessing applications on an ongoing basis, as we wish to welcome our new colleague as soon as possible, so click Apply Now and send us your CV today. If you have any questions, you are always welcome to contact us on tel. +45 8943 2000 and ask for Hans Jørgen Bohlbro, Vice President, Product Management.

Are you passionate about data and driven by the opportunity to make a real impact by helping companies turn facts into actionable insights? Do you thrive in dynamic environments where you work with some of the most complex and modern data solutions? If so, you might be our next colleague.

Responsibilities & technologies

In Data Management, you will become part of a team that contributes to enabling our customers to develop and manage their business based on data and knowledge.

You will work in the intersection of technology and business. Information and data are at the core of our work, and we can see that our analyses, advice, and final solutions create value for our customers. • Implementation of business logic on data for use in reporting.

• Customer advisory, strategy work, and business analysis in collaboration with our customers.

About you

You are newly graduated or have up to a couple of years of relevant professional experience within data management. Through your education, you have gained a solid professional foundation and a logical approach to handling complex data and challenges. To succeed in this role, you have experience with or the interest to learn:

Continue developing with us

All courses are taught by experienced Netcompany colleagues, ensuring that all content is highly relevant and builds upon your professional skills, preparing you for various tasks and continuously improving your expertise throughout your career with us.

Join an inclusive community

At Netcompany, we highly prioritise an inclusive community. We actively promote an open and welcoming work culture based on collaboration and mutual trust, where there is always an opportunity for sparring.

As we are an international company with offices in many countries, you will have the opportunity to learn and collaborate internationally with colleagues from across the world. We offer a shared environment where we engage with each other across departments and projects. Additionally, we have a wide range of social and professional events that provide you with the best opportunities to expand and build a network early in your career.

Send us your application

Responsibilities

• 
Participating in hair transplant procedures (FUE and/or FUT)

• 
Preparation and counting of hair follicles and assistance throughout the procedure

We expect you to

•

How to apply

Factbird helps manufacturers turn real-time production data into decisions they can actually act on. Since 2016, we've helped manufacturers in 28 countries cut waste, boost uptime, and run smarter — from the shop floor to the boardroom. Over 300 companies trust us to make sense of their operations, and we're a team of 80+ people across Copenhagen and the US who care about making complex things simple.

We're growing our engineering team and hiring several Full Stack Cloud Engineers — people who can move confidently across our stack: React on the front end, Rust and Node.js on the back end, and a multi-account AWS underneath it all.

About the Role

We're open on where your strengths sit. Some of these roles will lean more toward the back end — APIs, data pipelines, cloud infrastructure. Others will lean more toward the front end — the interfaces our customers use every day. What matters is that you're genuinely full stack: comfortable owning a feature end to end, and willing to work across the stack when the team needs it. We're not looking for anyone who only does front end or only does back end.

We’re looking for confident independent contributors that lean into ownership, are keen to shape architecture, and invest in mentoring others.

You'll fit right in if you've got a pragmatic, get-it-done mindset, a good instinct for testing and clean design, and you're just as happy explaining a technical trade-off to another engineer as to someone outside engineering.

**

What you'll do

**

Building & shipping

• Operate within a Nix-backed ecosystem from development tooling to cross-compiled build artifacts

• Own features end to end — from a rough idea or user story through to a shipped, tested, monitored piece of production software

• Build and maintain frontend features in React and backend services in TypeScript on Node.js and Rust, backed by a multi-account orchestrated AWS environment (Lambda, API Gateway, RDS, DynamoDB, EKS, and more, depending on the team)

• Write infrastructure as code (e.g. AWS CDK) for the systems you build

**

Team & growth**

• Take part in code reviews — giving and receiving feedback that makes the codebase better

• Contribute to sprint planning, story breakdown, and demos

• Design systems and data pipelines from scratch, mentor other engineers, author RFCs and architecture decisions, and help set technical standards for the team

About you

We're looking for engineers who've seen more than one way of doing things, and who'll bring that perspective to challenge how we do things here — with a pragmatic, get-it-done mindset that can turn ambiguity into a plan.

**

The ideal background**

• At least three years experience since graduating from a relevant Masters program

• Solid, hands-on experience across the full stack — frontend (React or equivalent) and backend (Rust/Node.js, or equivalent) — even if you have a natural preference for one side

• Comfort working with AWS or another major cloud provider

• A track record of shipping features independently, with a good instinct for testing, code quality, and clean design

• Good communication — you can explain a technical trade-off clearly, whether you're talking to another engineer or someone outside engineering. And you can do all this with strong English fluency.

• Experience designing systems from scratch, mentoring other engineers, or driving architecture decisions through to a decision

We welcome applicants from people eager to move to Denmark so long as you already have the legal right to live and work here. We can contribute to relocation costs for the right candidate.

Why Factbird?

People are at the heart of everything we build. We believe great products come from empowered teams — and we work hard to create an environment where you can do your best work and have space for life beyond it.

Here's what you can look forward to:

• Flexible working hours: We trust you to manage your time. Life isn't one-size-fits-all, and neither is work.

• Competitive salary: We offer compensation that reflects your skills, experience, and impact.

• Internet reimbursement: Stay connected and productive, wherever you choose to work from.

• Thoughtful, human onboarding: We'll support you step by step, giving you the context, tools, and guidance you need to feel confident from day one.

• A career path that grows with you: Through bi-yearly Individual Development Plan conversations, we'll work together to shape a career journey that fits your ambitions.

• Company-wide gatherings & team days: We regularly come together across teams and regions to connect, celebrate, and align on what's next.

• A global, inclusive culture: We're proud of our diverse backgrounds and perspectives — and we actively celebrate them in how we work and collaborate.

**

We'd love to hear from you**

If this role feels like a match, we'd be excited to hear from you and explore how you could help shape the future of data collection and production monitoring at Factbird.

And if someone in your network comes to mind who might be a great fit — feel free to share this opportunity with them.

Have questions? You can always reach out at **khma@factbird.com

**

_

jobs.occupation: Warehouse Employee with a Flair for Technology - Slagelse - ShowTech Event Group
jobs.description:
Warehouse employee with flair for technology - Slagelse

Do you thrive in a fast-paced environment where you are part of the responsibility for orders being packed on time and the warehouse generally structured and neat? Are you structured and do you have a good overview of your daily workflow? If so, you may be the new warehouse employee we are looking for!

You will be part of an inspiring and fast-growing brand with a large selection of tasks within the event industry. We are growing and our everyday life is getting busier. We are looking for a warehouse man/woman with a great drive, a good sense of structure and with suberb packing abilities.

About ShowTech

We are one of Denmark's leading suppliers and production companies within the event industry, with a stock of over 7000m2 of various event timens and technology. Our everyday life is characterized by a lot of different tasks and you will therefore not see the same colleagues every day, as we are very much out on different locations. We are a company in rapid development and with lots of speed.

Job description

At ShowTech, no two days are alike. We are very busy in the warehouse and therefore also have many different tasks to offer. You will, among other things, be responsible for packing, sorting, cleaning, preparation and quality assurance, however, there may be periods of working outside these areas. We are looking for a warehouse employee who has experience and someone who dares to take extra responsibility for the tasks being completed correctly.

With primary reference to the warehouse manager, your tasks in collaboration with colleagues are the following

• Inventory registration and inventory structure

• Ordet packing

• Clean-up and cleaning

• Control/quality assurance of the incoming and outgoing orders

• Ad hoc tasks

There may be periods when you are given temporary responsibility.

We imagine that the right candidate has the following qualifications:

• You thrive in a busy environment, are solution-oriented and dare to communicate and ask

• Takes pride in the fact that the job is well done and correctly from A to Z

• We prefer that you have a truck certificate and experience with systematic warehouse work

• You have a great gair and a good physique

• You are structured, detail-oriented and have a good overview

• You can work in a team, as well as work independently

• Can take overtime for periods if needed

• Knowledge of the event industry is a big plus

You as a person:

At ShowTech, we work closely with colleagures in the warehouse as well as among the various departmens. It is therefore a big plus if you as a person is outgoing. We are good at complementing each other and care a lot about a good togetherness. In addition, we expect you to be punctual and keep to your meeting times and appointments, as the daily tasks may vary. You are not afraid to take responsibility, but at the same time you're not afraid to ask an extra time if you're in doubt.

We can offer:

• A challenging job with a varied and exciting everyday life

• A job in a company with both fixed tasks, but also short and fast decision-making processes

• A close bond between colleagues, where we help and care for each other

• A fixed salary, health insurance and pension

Are you our next warehouse employee?

Do you fit our description and feel that you can help us with our further journey? Send your CV and a motivated application to Linda@showtech.dk. If you have questions about the position, you can always write to Linda@showtech.dk. We look forward to hearing from you!

jobs.occupation: Project Manager – Lead the Journey from Concept to Production
jobs.description:
Are you a decisive, technically grounded project manager who thrives on turning complex ideas into real, manufacturable products?

Do you enjoy connecting people, creating direction, and driving progress in environments where engineering excellence matters? This is your opportunity to take a central role in shaping how we bring innovative electronics products to market — faster, smarter, and better.

Your Role

You will join our project management team in BU Product, currently consisting of three Project Managers, and report to the Head of Engineering, BU Product. The Engineering function includes Project Managers, two Team Leads and approximately 45 engineers working across different technical disciplines.

BU Product is responsible for developing and maintaining the standard products in our portfolio – the building blocks used to create our satellites. We work closely with our Product Managers, who define the portfolio and product roadmap. From there, our responsibility is to turn the roadmap into reality, taking product development from the initial phases through development and industrialization to running production.

As Project Manager, you will lead engineering projects across multiple teams and disciplines and manage several development streams simultaneously. You will create direction and momentum across engineering, operations and suppliers, ensuring that plans, dependencies and risks are visible and actively managed.

You will also support Product Owners in the early scoping of projects and work closely with the Product Engineering Manager on project status, escalations and corrective actions.

Your tasks include:

• Manage end-to-end project execution by translating requirements into structured development plans and ensuring progression from concept through to manufacturable solutions

• Develop and maintain cross-team project plans that align priorities, dependencies, timelines and deliverables across engineering, operations and supplier interfaces

• Facilitate concurrent engineering by engaging relevant disciplines early and supporting effective cross-functional decision-making

• Monitor project progress, maintain risk visibility and initiate timely corrective actions to address deviations, constraints or delays

• Coordinate with suppliers and internal stakeholders to support on-time delivery of critical parts and alignment with project commitments

• Contribute to developing and implementing a fit-for-purpose product development model that strengthens time-to-market, scalability and continuous improvement across BU Product

What You Bring:

You’re an experienced project manager with a strong engineering foundation and a solid understanding of what it takes to move complex electronics and software products from concept to manufacturable reality. You know that successful project management is as much about people as it is about plans. You communicate clearly across technical and non-technical stakeholders, ask the right questions, follow up proactively and bring different disciplines together around a shared direction.

You likely:

• Hold a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electronics Engineering or equivalent

• Have 5+ years of experience within electronics and software product development

• Bring documented experience leading technical development projects

• Understand and practice concurrent engineering principles

• Excel at creating structure and enabling effective cross-functional collaboration

Who you are:

• Helpfulness – you support teams, ask purposeful questions and pursue the answers you need

• Open communication – you communicate transparently and proactively and follow through

• True leadership – you take ownership, act with integrity and drive progress with confidence

• Structure & clarity – you create overview and direction in a dynamic environment

• Human insight – you listen, understand different perspectives and turn input into clear conclusions

Here’s why you’ll love working with us:

At GomSpace, we’re on a mission to shape the future of space – one mission at a time. Here, you’ll be part of something bigger than just a project or a product. You’ll help build systems that connect people, enable science and expand humanity’s reach beyond Earth.

We believe the best results come when talented people are trusted, supported and inspired to push boundaries together.

• Be part of a global company making a real impact in the space industry

• Get freedom under responsibility from day one – and grow with us

• Join a dynamic, full-service environment where no two days are alike

• Work across borders and build a strong international network

• Be part of a culture where collaboration beats competition – and milestones are celebrated together

Join our mission

You are welcome to send your application in English. Interviews will be conducted on a continuous basis. Apply for the job by following the link below.

If you have any questions regarding the position, do not hesitate to contact Anne Katrine Windfeld, Head of Engineering, BU Product. E-mail: akwi@gomspace.com

The workplace will be at our premises at Langagervej 6, Aalborg, Denmark. Salary and start date will be individually negotiated.

As part of our recruitment process, employment requires you to complete a background check conducted by an authorized third-party provider in accordance with applicable legislation.

At GomSpace WE MAKE SPACE YOURS.

GomSpace is a globally leading designer, integrator and manufacturer of high-end nano and microsatellites for customers in the academic, government and commercial markets. Our positions of strength include systems integration, small satellite subsystems and advanced miniaturized radio technology. At the core of our mission are our core values: Be helpful, communicate openly and frequently, and show true leadership.

Our international team is devoted to understanding our customers’ requirements and delivering high quality. We are listed in Stockholm (GOMX), headquartered in Denmark and have subsidiaries in Sweden, Singapore, France, North America and Luxembourg. We have more than 200 employees servicing customers in more than 60 countries. Learn more on www.gomspace.com

Join us in shaping the future of space exploration!

If you have any questions, please contact

Anne Katrine Windfeld

akwi@gomspace.com

Senior Software Engineer | Machine Control

Help shape the future of machine automation.

Every day, construction professionals around the world rely on Leica Geosystems technology to work more safely, efficiently, and more sustainable.

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer with expertise in kinematics and control systems to join our On-Machine Software team in Odense, Denmark, or Stockholm, Sweden. In this role, you will develop the software that enable construction machines to operate with greater precision, automation, and autonomy.

About the role

You will be part of the On-Machine Software department, where we design and develop developing technology used every day on construction sites around the world. Our software allows construction machines to understand their surroundings and execute precise movements.

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will contribute across the full software development lifecycle, from concept and architecture discussions to implementation, testing, and operational support. You will collaborate with software, hardware, and product teams to deliver robust, high-quality solutions.

A particular focus of this role will be supporting and evolving key machine control applications while contributing expertise in system design, software architecture, kinematics, control systems, sensor integration, and advanced software development practices.

What you’ll do

• Develop and maintain software for machine control and automation systems.

• Contribute to technical decisions, architecture, and system design.

• Take ownership of key software components and drive improvements.

• Collaborate across software, hardware, and product teams to deliver reliable solutions.

• Develop machine guidance, automation, and control functionality.

• Participate in technical reviews and mentoring of colleagues.

• Work with sensor integration, positioning technologies, and control algorithms.

• Contribute to technical investigations and innovation initiatives.

What you'll bring

You have a degree in Software Engineering, Robotics, Control Engineering, or a related technical discipline and several years of professional software development experience.

You thrive on tackling complex system-level challenges and are often the person colleagues turn to for technical guidance. While you work well independently when needed, you also enjoy collaborating with others and sharing your expertise in our global organization.

We expect you to have:

• Strong C++ development skills.

• Experience developing software on Linux-based platforms.

• Experience working across the full software development lifecycle.

• Understanding of software architecture principles and object-oriented design.

• Experience developing sensor-fusion and state-estimation solutions.

• Deep understanding of kinematic modelling and control systems, ideally applied to robotics, mobile machinery, hydraulic systems, or automation.

Additional experience:

• Experience with embedded and real-time software development.

• CAN, CANopen, or similar communication technologies.

• Understanding of CRA, cybersecurity compliance, and secure software development practices.

• Experience developing safety-critical or safety-certified software.

• Experience from heavy construction, industrial automation, agriculture, or related industries.

• GNSS, positioning systems, or machine guidance solutions.

Language: Fluent English, both written and verbal, is a prerequisite.

Travel: Occasional travel may be required, for example to visit other development locations.

Your workplace

At Leica Geosystems, you will be working on technology that truly matters to the people who use it. For over 40 years, we've helped construction professionals build more efficiently, more safely, and more sustainably. Our products are used in more than 80 countries and are integrated with over 10 leading OEM construction machinery manufacturers. Today, more than 10,000 of our systems shape roads, railways, and infrastructure every day.

Leica Geosystems Machine Control is part of Hexagon's Infrastructure & Geospatial Business Area. Hexagon is the global leader in digital reality solutions, combining sensor, software, and autonomous technologies. Because when it has to be right, it has to be Hexagon.

We believe in a work environment characterised by humour, engagement, and opportunities for growth.

Three good reasons to join us:

• Build technology that moves the world and help construction machines work with millimetre precision.

• Push the boundaries of automation, and help develop smarter, more autonomous construction machines.

• Enjoy the freedom to do your best work and join a team built on trust and flexibility,

Read more here:

Om os | Leica Geosystems

Jobmuligheder | Leica Geosystems

Interested or know someone who is?

Apply using this link and upload your CV and covering letter in English.

Interviews will be held as and when relevant candidates apply. All applications are treated as fully confidential.

For questions regarding the position, please get in touch with Martin Skriver, (martin.skriver@leica-geosystems.com) or People Partner, Katja Sørensen (+45 2011 1723).

At Leica Geosystems, we are committed to promoting diversity and inclusion and encourage all qualified candidates to apply regardless of gender identity, age, or cultural background.

We kindly but firmly refrain from direct contact with staffing and recruitment companies as well as sellers of additional job advertisements.

Desired Skills

• Strong C++ development skills.

• Experience developing software on Linux-based platforms.

• Experience working across the full software development lifecycle.

• Understanding of software architecture principles and object-oriented design.

• Experience developing sensor-fusion and state-estimation solutions.

• Deep understanding of kinematic modelling and control systems, ideally applied to robotics, mobile machinery, hydraulic systems, or automation.

Senior Manager, Software Cyber Security

Job Description

Would you like to work with Cyber Security for Industrial Systems in a company that develops and maintains highly complex, mission critical systems for a global market? Then take this opportunity to create something that matters.

Join us to apply your expertise within Cyber Security of complex software products and projects for logistics centres and airports worldwide. Take on this exciting and demanding leadership challenge to help us deliver integrated Cyber Security for vital infrastructure solutions.

Join a software center of excellence

You join BEUMER Group to become responsible for our Cyber Security activities for our portfolio of technically complex software products and projects for automated baggage handling systems and parcel sorters. These mission critical systems are installed across international airports and logistics centers as a completely essential part of daily operations 24/7/365. We have the leading products on the market, and the office in Aarhus, Denmark, is an international center of excellence within the BEUMER organization.

Cyber Security for industrial systems

Specifically, you become responsible for monitoring and implementing best practices within Cyber Security for industrial systems. Focus is on Cyber Security for the systems that we deliver to our customers. We comply with internationally recognized standards and have a process-oriented approach as Cyber Security is part of all aspects of what we do.

You will have a close dialogue with both our software product organization and our software project organization and our project IT-Infrastructure team. You will quite naturally be working closely with our Software Process Improvement department, and you will report to the Global Software Director.

Leader of a specialist team

You will be leading a small team of highly professional cyber security specialists while at the same time driving cyber security across BEUMERs global software team in close collaboration with BEUEMRs CISO team. As such you will be in dialog with group companies and product and project departments coordinating cyber security initiatives and communicating Cyber Security strategy, roadmap and best practices.

Skilled in Cyber Security

As responsible for our Cyber Security activities, your task is to enable the organization to deliver Cyber Secure software products, projects and services needed for mission critical systems. To do so, we believe you:

• Have a relevant master’s degree related to software development and/or cyber security

• Experience in analyzing a software organization's cybersecurity priorities and practices

• You have at least 2 years’ of relevant experience in the cybersecurity field.

• Previous work experience with applying or using frameworks such as ISA/IEC 62443, EU CRA, NIS2 and ISO27001/2 in an international environment.

• Relevant security certifications (CISSP, CCSK etc.) are a plus

Other than that, we would also like you to:

• Be structured, factual and have well-developed analytical and problem-solving skills with practical ability to shape the Cybersecurity agenda.

• Thrive in a fast-paced international environment with many stakeholders

• Have a good understanding of technologies and methodologies within software development

• Possess solid leadership skills and strong in stakeholder management and communication knowing how to create buy-in and setting direction.

• Have knowledge about agile software development processes, CMMI and similar methods and standards would be an advantage.

• Be PMI, IPMA or Prince2 certified or similar training/certification would be a plus.

Some travel must be expected as we are an international organisation. Therefore we expect you to communicate fluently in English.

To lead our cyber security activities, you will in addition to the above need drive, energy, and good commutation and stakeholder management skills. You have the experience to facilitate improvement initiatives and implement changes in an organization.

Interested?

If you have any questions regarding this position, please do not hesitate to contact Talent Acquisition Lead Søren Elkjær Holm on +45 3176 0448.

Choosing Capgemini means choosing a company where you will be empowered to shape your career in the way you’d like, where you’ll be supported and inspired by a collaborative community of colleagues around the world, and where you’ll be able to reimagine what’s possible. Join us and help the world’s leading organizations unlock the value of technology and build a more sustainable, more inclusive world. Capgemini’s Global Insights & Data business line is a market leader in data, analytics, and cloud platforms across multiple industries, including financial services, life sciences, consumer products, utilities, and the public sector.

Your Role

As a Data Architect, you will work with leading organizations to design and govern enterprise-grade data architectures that enable analytics, reporting, operational data products, real-time processing, and AI-driven use cases. You will combine strategic architectural ownership with hands-on collaboration, translating business needs into scalable designs and ensuring alignment across platforms, teams, and standards.

As a key part of your activities, you will act as a trusted technical advisor, translate business and AI-use cases into scalable architecture designs, review data pipelines and models for alignment with standards, and contribute to documentation, design reviews, and architectural decision-making forums.

In this role you will play a key role in:

• Define and evolve enterprise data architecture including principles, standards, and reference models, ensuring consistent alignment across platforms, teams, and business objectives

• Design end-to-end data solutions and modern lakehouse architectures that support batch, streaming, real-time processing, and AI-driven use cases

• Lead event-driven and real-time data strategies, while ensuring that architectures are scalable, secure, and compliant with regulatory and governance requirements

• Establish and govern standards across data modeling, SQL, metadata, lineage, data quality, and security, while defining approaches for schema evolution, temporal data modeling, incremental processing, and resilient data pipelines

Your profile

• Extensive experience with enterprise data platforms, including several years in architecture-focused roles, designing solutions that support advanced analytics and AI use cases

• Strong understanding of modern data platform principles, including lakehouse architecture, event-driven and streaming patterns, and real-time processing strategies for analytics and AI applications

• Strong proficiency in SQL and data modeling patterns, including Star schema (Kimball), Data Vault, hybrid approaches, and temporal data models (e.g., SCD Type 2), with the ability to design models that support both traditional BI and AI/ML workloads

• Solid knowledge of data governance and compliance, covering metadata management, data lineage, quality, and audit requirements to ensure trusted and usable data across platforms

• Hands-on experience with at least one major cloud platform (Microsoft Azure, AWS or Google Cloud Platform) combined with strong communication skills, enabling translation of complex technical concepts into clear architectural guidance for technical and business stakeholders

What we believe you will enjoy about working here

Choosing Capgemini means choosing a company where you can shape your career, work with a diverse collective of experts, and help leading organizations unlock the value of data responsibly.

At Capgemini, you will:

• Work on enterprise-scale, mission-critical data platforms

• Influence data architecture standards across industries

• Balance innovation with regulatory and operational excellence

• Be a part of a collaborative culture that values innovation, entrepreneurship, and continuous learning

Application

If you are ready to take the next step in your career, leading organizations to design and govern enterprise-grade data architecture, we look forward to receiving your application.

We review applications on an ongoing basis and encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

As part of our recruitment process, identity verification will be conducted through inspection of your ID card, and background checks may be carried out as require

Help us shape the future of sustainable shipping

At Coach Solutions, we develop software that empowers the global shipping industry to work smarter and make data-driven decisions that matter — for both profit and sustainability. Backed by Kongsberg Maritime, we’re entering a pivotal new phase, modernizing our architecture and scaling our impact.

We’re looking for a Platform & DevOps Engineer to join our growing platform & development department. In this key role, you will work closely with developers and QA engineers to support and evolve our platform. You’ll be responsible for designing, building, and maintaining our Azure-based infrastructure and CI/CD pipelines. Experience with Azure DevOps, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), and cloud-native architecture is essential.

What you’ll do

As a Platform & DevOps Engineer in Coach Solutions, you’ll shape how we build, deploy, and scale our SaaS solutions. Working alongside developers, QAs, and key stakeholders, you will develop and maintain our Azure- infrastructure, streamline CI/CD processes, and enhance automation. By embedding structure, security, and reliability into our platform operations, you’ll enable faster, more confident development, and free up our engineers to focus on what they do best. You’ll be the bridge between development and operations, setting the foundation for how we work going forward.

Your job scope includes

• Designing, building, and maintaining scalable Azure infrastructure using infrastructure-as-code (IaC).

• Implementing and documenting best practices for platform security, observability, and performance.

• Enhancing deployment reliability, automation flows, and build transparency to support QA and test teams

• Collaborating with developers to define and refine DevOps processes, tooling, and ownership boundaries.

• Documenting infrastructure, environments, workflows, and test automation to promote transparency and reproducibility

What we’re looking for

You have at least 3 years of hands-on experience working with Azure services, CI/CD pipelines, and infrastructure-as-code. Your educational background is within computer science or software development, and you have practical experience from and thrive working in a SaaS company. In addition, you’re:

• Experienced working with Kubernetes and containerized workloads in cloud-native environments

• Hands-on experience with our core stack: AKS, Azure DevOps, Pulumi or Terraform, and GitOps tooling such as ArgoCD or Flux.

• Maintaining and improving monitoring, alerting, and logging infrastructure to ensure operational visibility across environments using Grafana, Azure Monitor, and Application Insights.

• AI fluent and curious about how AI-assisted development, automation, and operational tooling can improve engineering workflows and delivery quality.

• Familiar with modern engineering tooling and practices around automation, scripting, and developer enablement.

Personal traits we are looking for

• You have a strong sense of ownership, accountability, and proactive problem-solving

• Are skilled at cross-functional collaboration across development, testing, and operations

• Are passionate about building and continuously improving scalable systems, processes, and infrastructure

• Are naturally curious, technology-driven, and motivated by continuous learning and knowledge sharing

• Enjoy both working independently and within a team

What you will get

Coach Solutions is continuously evolving, creating exciting opportunities for you to take on new responsibility, expand your role, and shape your career path. We are eager to support you in your development: both professionally and personally. You will experience:

• A purpose-driven workplace at the intersection of tech and sustainability

• A flexible work environment, with opportunity to work from home – we want you to stay for a long time

• A social workplace with an informal, relaxed atmosphere, and of course all the celebrations one could wish for: Monthly Friday bars, team events, Summer and Winter party, a family event and much more

• A team that values autonomy, and personal impact, if you see the problem, you own it! And if you make the best argument, you win, no matter your title.

• Highly skilled colleagues with an engineering mindset, that is eager to help you succeed

• A skilled and experienced mentor, that looks forward to taking you under his wing

Doesn’t check all the boxes?

That’s okay, we’d still love to hear from you. Reach out and let’s build something meaningful together.

We are looking for a motivated scientist with strong scientific expertise to join our international Applications team. As part of Commercial Operations, the team works closely with Sales, Marketing, Customer Support, Product Management, and R&D to help customers succeed with Evosep technology.

In this role, you will combine hands-on science, scientific communication, and cross-functional collaboration. You will help test and validate new products, generate high-quality scientific data, and translate complex results into clear, actionable insights for internal and external audiences. The position is based at our headquarters in Odense, Denmark, with a hybrid work setup. Occasional travel, typically once a month, is expected.

You will join a collaborative and international team driven by curiosity, continuous learning, and a shared belief that we achieve more together. Our ambition is to help scientists accelerate breakthroughs and advance precision medicine through robust, high-throughput proteomics workflows.

What We Do

Evosep aims to improve quality of life and patient care by radically innovating protein based clinical diagnostics. Making sample preparation and separation before MS analysis 10 times faster and 100 times more robust will enable truly large cohort studies for biomarker validation and provide the foundation for precision medicine.

Key Tasks and Responsibilities

• Generate high-quality, reproducible LC-MS/MS data that supports product management, marketing, and customer-facing activities.

• Design, execute, and evaluate experiments that help demonstrate the performance, robustness, and value of Evosep technology.

• Interpret complex scientific datasets and translate results into clear, actionable insights for internal teams and external audiences.

• Stay current on emerging technologies and methodologies.

• Provide scientific subject matter expertise across Commercial Operations, Support, Marketing, Product Management, and R&D.

• Represent Evosep externally and travel approximately once per month to support customer engagement, conferences, collaborations, and industry activities.

Qualifications

Your most important qualification is your personality! We care about hiring people who we believe can thrive and develop at Evosep. Our team is diverse, but a positive cando attitude and the desire to be part of something bigger than yourself are common characteristics for the entire team. To be successful in this role, you should also ideally bring:

• An Ph.D. in Biochemistry, Molecular Biology, Analytical Sciences or related fields, with a strong foundation in experimental science.

• Hands-on experience developing and executing high-throughput proteomics workflows, including sample preparation, LC-MS/MS instrument operation, and data quality control in a research or product development environment.

• Strong data analysis and scientific problem-solving skills, with the ability to critically evaluate data and consider experimental design.

• Experience in biopharma setting would be a plus.

• Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills with experience in multidisciplinary teams.

• Excellent scientific writing skills in English, with the ability to communicate complex concepts clearly through application notes, posters, and technical documentation.

• Proactive, curious, and collaborative mindset, with the motivation to contribute to a fast-moving international team.

We know that great candidates may not meet every requirement listed. If you are excited about the role and believe your experience, curiosity, and collaborative mindset could make a difference at Evosep, we encourage you to apply.

What We Offer

• A team of passionate, ambitious, and supporting colleagues with a can-do mentality and a strong belief in our ability to make a real difference with what we do.

• An innovative, open, and dynamic culture where we continuously learn and develop.

• The possibility to join a rapidly growing company in the life science industry where you will contribute to solutions for improving quality of life and patient care.

• A competitive benefits package and lunch arrangement.

• Flexible work hours and work-life balance.

• New, modern office facilities in Odense.

• The list goes on, learn more about us on www.evosep.com/careers.

Does This Position Sound Like A Match?

Hit the apply button below to apply for the position. We are looking forward to hearing from you!

What Happens After I Send My Application?

We are looking for someone who can join our team as soon as possible. We will conduct interviews continuously and we reserve the right to close the job advert as soon as the position has been filled, so do not hesitate to send us an application. It is important to us that we respond to all candidates who have spent time sending us an application and you will always as a minimum receive an email with a response once the hiring process is over.

Are you ready to take ownership of an experienced sales team and drive its commercial performance to the next level in a specialised Nordic technology business? Join Ramcon and play a key role in developing both people and performance in a company built on expertise, strong customer relationships and long-term partnerships.

Ramcon is a leading Nordic distributor of advanced solutions within Life Science, Healthcare, Medical Technology, Chemistry and Industrial applications. Since 1988, the company has built its market position through strong supplier partnerships, deep technical expertise and long-term customer relationships. Today, Ramcon employs approximately 80 employees across Denmark and Sweden and operates from offices in Birkerød, Aarhus, Stockholm and Gothenburg.

Lead a specialised sales team

The Sales Manager will be responsible for an established team of six Product Specialists and for driving the continued commercial development of the business area. The position combines people leadership, commercial management and business development, with responsibility for translating strategic ambitions into operational activities and measurable results.

Working closely with customers, suppliers and internal stakeholders, the Sales Manager will contribute to strengthening Ramcon’s market position, developing existing customer relationships and identifying new commercial opportunities. The role also carries responsibility for maintaining a strong sales culture, ensuring structured sales execution and supporting key strategic business opportunities.

Key responsibilities include:

• Leadership, coaching and development of six Product Specialists

• Sales strategy implementation and commercial development

• Budgeting, forecasting and pipeline management

• Development of strategic customer and supplier relationships

• Support of larger and strategically important sales opportunities

• Driving commercial excellence and sales performance

Commercial leadership with strategic influence

The Sales Manager will play a key role in ensuring continued growth and organizational development. Success in the position requires an ability to combine strategic perspective with operational execution while creating engagement, accountability and performance across the organization.

The position offers significant influence on the future commercial development of the business and close collaboration with customers, suppliers, and internal stakeholders across the organisation.

Your profile

The ideal candidate is an experienced commercial leader with a proven track record of creating results through strong sales leadership and structured execution. Experience from a specialised technical B2B environment is considered an advantage.

Furthermore, the successful candidate is expected to have:

• Experience leading specialist sales teams

• Strong commercial and business development capabilities

• Experience managing complex sales processes involving multiple stakeholders

• A coaching and performance-oriented leadership style

• The ability to build trust across customers, suppliers and internal stakeholders

Experience from Life Science, Diagnostics, Laboratory Solutions, Medical Technology or a related technical industry would be considered very beneficial.

OJ Electronics is looking for a hardware development manager to lead one of the core development units within our R&D organization. This is a central leadership role focused on strengthening both engineering capability and development capacity across our product portfolio.

OJ Electronics – a Danish producer of HVAC drives, AHU controllers, and thermostats for electric floor heating – is looking for an experienced engineering leader to join our R&D organization in Sønderborg, Denmark.

In this role, you will lead a team of approximately 10 specialists within hardware and mechanical engineering, supporting the continued development of new products and technologies across OJ’s three main product areas. You’ll combine people leadership, technical understanding, resource coordination, and process improvement in a dynamic development environment with close collaboration across R&D, product management, and senior leadership.

As part of OJ’s broader R&D leadership team, you’ll help shape development priorities, strengthen engineering processes, and contribute to an organization where ideas quickly become action.

Your role

As hardware development manager, you’ll be responsible for the daily leadership and continued development of OJ’s hardware team.

Your specific responsibilities will include:

• Leading and developing the hardware team

• Supporting employee development and long-term competence building

• Allocating development resources across projects and priorities

• Participating as part of OJ’s R&D leadership team alongside fellow department leaders

• Collaborating with external development partners

• Managing budgets and follow-up activities for hardware development

• Contributing to process optimization and continuous improvement across development activities

Must-have qualifications

• Engineering degree in electronics or a related technical field

• Leadership experience – preferably within product development or technical organizations

• Strong technical understanding of electronics and hardware development

• Experience leading technical specialists and cross-functional collaboration

• Strong communication skills in both Danish and English

• Structured leadership approach with focus on collaboration, overview, and execution

• Ability to balance empathy and listening skills with clear decision-making when needed

Nice-to-have qualifications

• Experience working with hardware development and MCAD/ECAD tools

• Experience working with development processes in companies with dedicated R&D organizations

• Understanding of both technical development and organizational process improvement

• Experience collaborating with external development partners

• Interest in leadership development and building strong engineering teams

Working at OJ

At OJ Electronics, you’ll find an informal, open and collaborative culture where people take pride in doing quality work.

We offer:

• A flat organisational structure where decisions are made quickly

• Opportunities to grow your expertise and responsibility over time

• A healthy work-life balance and flexible working hours

• Competitive salary and pension package

• A modern workplace with canteen and good facilities

Employee satisfaction scores average above 85 – and we take pride in maintaining a workplace where people truly thrive.

Please note that this position is based in Sønderborg, Denmark, and requires your physical presence on site. This is not a hybrid or remote position.

The application process

For this position, we will be interviewing on an ongoing basis until we find the right person.

About OJ Electronics

Founded in 1964 and headquartered in Sønderborg, Denmark, OJ Electronics produces electronic controls for underfloor heating and HVAC controls and drives. Our products are available through partners and distributors worldwide, and we have subsidiaries and sales offices in key markets, including the United States and Poland. Everywhere, we are known for our innovative approach, insistence on product quality, and deep application knowledge – all of which helps customers differentiate themselves in the market.

In June 2023, OJ Electronics was acquired by BITZER Electronics, a BITZER Group company also headquartered in Sønderborg. This makes OJ Electronics part of the BITZER Group family, which is represented at 75 locations in over 40 countries and employs some 4300 people worldwide, 185 in OJ Electronics, Sønderborg, Denmark.

Creative Video Producer

• Full-time

Company Description

Do you know how to turn ideas into engaging video content? Are you passionate about storytelling, visual communication, and creating content that people want to watch? Then you might be the Creative Video Producer we’re looking for.

At JYSK, video is a key part of how we communicate with customers and colleagues across more than 30 countries. We’re looking for a creative and hands-on Video Producer who can take ownership of productions from concept to final delivery – and who thrives working across formats, platforms, and audiences.

WHAT WE OFFER YOU

At JYSK, you’ll become part of an ambitious and creative Marketing department where ideas are turned into high-quality content seen across international markets.

Furthermore, we offer you:

• The opportunity to shape and develop video production in an international retail brand

• Ownership of productions from concept to final delivery together with the team

• Close collaboration with colleagues across countries, departments and disciplines

• A creative environment where no two days are the same

• Skilled colleagues who value teamwork, sparring and continuous development

• The chance to influence how JYSK tells its stories through moving images

WHAT YOUR NEXT JOB WILL BE ABOUT

As our Creative Video Producer, you’ll create engaging video content that strengthens the JYSK brand externally and internally. Some Productions you’ll lead yourself from start to finish, while others you’ll coordinate together with different stakeholders.

Your tasks and responsibilities in the job include:

Healper a game-changing booking platform that matches people with mental health issues such as depression, anxiety, and addiction with the psychologist who fits their needs. Problem: The cumbersome booking of the wrong psychologist In Denmark, mental disorders account for 25% of the disease burden and cost society 55 billion DKK annually with more than 2,000 people receiving therapy from a psychologist every day. Further, too many individuals do not receive timely help as they cannot cope with the draining 5-hour process it takes to find and book a psychologist. At the same time, U.S. experience shows that only 20-40% of people find a psychologist they trust and have 'chemistry' with. This is tragic, as just one bad experience can cause a client to completely drop out of or postpone his/her therapy. The ineffective booking process and the risk of a poor patient-therapist match mean that many people continue to struggle with mental illness who could otherwise be treated. This has major consequences for individuals whose mental illness markedly impairs their quality of life, but also largely affect their family and friends. Furthermore, this is a major problem for society, which is negatively impacted by lost labor and growth and must shoulder the high costs associated with mental illness. Solution: A simple approach to booking the right psychologist Healper is a friendly guide and a booking platform that matches clients with psychologists. We have designed a comfortable, simple, and transparent user journey, that takes the client by the hand and helps him/her through therapy to mental health. Clients fill out a short questionnaire and are then matched with the best results from our database of more than 1,700 psychologists. Here, we find the psychologist who can statistically give the best treatment. Clients are presented with a prioritized list of three psychologists along with the reasons for the match. From this list, clients can choose which psychologist they like best, book a session, and pay. The platform continuously facilitates feedback from clients and their psychologists to improve the processing and precision of the matches.

We’re expanding the development team behind our Drives product portfolio and are looking for a power electronics hardware engineer with experience in power electronics development. This position focuses on developing the hardware platforms our drives are built on.

OJ Electronics – a Danish producer of HVAC drives, AHU controllers, and thermostats for electric floor heating – is looking for a hardware engineer to join our Hardware R&D team in Sønderborg, Denmark.

In this role, you will work in cross-functional development teams alongside specialists in software, mechanics, testing, and product management. Your work will involve transforming technical requirements and product ideas into robust hardware designs that meet demanding performance, quality, and regulatory requirements.

Your involvement will apply from the earliest concept and simulation stages to validation and final implementation – with opportunities to influence technical decisions and product performance throughout.

Your role

As part of the hardware development team, you’ll help design, validate and improve the power electronics hardware that forms the foundation of our drives platform.

Your specific responsibilities will include:

• Participating in development activities from concept phase through production release

• Developing power electronics hardware for motor-control and broader drive applications

• Translating technical requirements into hardware designs and implementations

• Performing simulations, validation, and verification of hardware designs

• Resolving technical challenges related to performance, reliability, and compliance

• Collaborating closely with software, testing, mechanics, and product management teams

• Supporting testing and validation activities related to standards and special application requirements

Must-have qualifications

• Master’s degree or engineering degree in electronics or a related field

• Experience with electronic design and hardware development – preferably power electronics

• Experience with inverter design, DC-link design, thermal design and derating, EMC

• Experience validating electronic hardware through testing and verification

• Knowledge of power electronics and motor-control systems

• Experience working with ACIM, PMSM, or BLDC motor technologies

• Strong communication skills in English, written and spoken

Nice-to-have qualifications

• Experience with simulation tools such as MATLAB or similar platforms

• Experience developing hardware for drives or motor-control applications

Working at OJ

• Opportunities to grow your expertise and responsibility over time

About OJ Electronics

Founded in 1964 and headquartered in Sønderborg, Denmark, OJ Electronics produces electronic controls for underfloor heating and HVAC controls and drives. Our products are available through partners and distributors worldwide, and we have subsidiaries and sales offices in key markets, including the United States and Poland. Everywhere, we are known for our innovative approach, insistence on product quality, and deep application knowledge – all of which helps customers differentiate themselves in the market.
